Context: 7. Repaying Capacity.-

## 7. Repaying Capacity.-  
The repaying capacity of the official will be computed on the following basis:-  
| Length of remaining service | Length of remaining service | Repaying Capacity |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| (a) | In cases of employee retiring after 20 years. | 40% of Basic Pay. |
